guide.tagline: Browse and safely edit your databases without leaving your Mac.
guide.summary: Save a connection to PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, Redis and more, then browse tables, run queries and edit rows. Risky changes are previewed and need your confirmation first. Passwords stay in your Keychain.

steps.title: Add a connection
steps.detail: Pick your database type and enter its host, or choose a file for SQLite.

steps.title: Open it
steps.detail: Edith connects and shows the tables, collections or keys inside.

steps.title: Browse and filter
steps.detail: Look through records, search, sort and filter without writing a query.

steps.title: Review before changing
steps.detail: Edits show exactly what will change and wait for your confirmation.

examples: ed database connections add notes --product postgresql
